tasks.gr7-mali-and-timbuktu-in-the-fourteenth-: Topic: Mali and Timbuktu in the fourteenth century. Cover trans-Saharan trade, camel caravans, Mansa Musa, Islam, manuscripts, and learning centres in Timbuktu. Ask Grade 7 learners to analyse short sources, sequence events, identify cause and consequence, and choose evidence-based historical conclusions.
